content:
“Share and share alike!”

**Philanthropist** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Restore some of your teammates' hunger and thirst when you eat or drink.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Restore much more of your team's hunger and thirst when you eat or drink. | 003808BF | 
| ★★ | 2 | Restore more of your team's hunger and thirst when you eat or drink. | 003808BE | 
| ★ | 1 | Restore some of your team's hunger and thirst when you eat or drink. | 003808B0 | 

- Dromedary and Slow Metabolizer increase the amount of hunger and thirst restored for team members as well as yourself.
- This perk's effectiveness is limited to a range of approximately 2 C.A.M.P foundations.
